State Farm Stadium Overview

The Super Bowl Transportation Challenge

Logistics by Day

Pre-Game Sunday

8:00 AM - Tailgate areas open
12:00 PM - Stadium gates open
4:30 PM - Kickoff

Post-Game

8:00 PM - Game ends (approximate)
8:30 PM - Parking lot chaos begins
10:00 PM - Most vehicles still in lots
11:00 PM - Areas finally clearing

Our Post-Game Strategy

  • Pre-positioned at designated zones

  • Alternative exit routes

Venue Area

Westgate Entertainment District

  • Restaurants and bars

Getting There

From Scottsdale: 30-45 minutes (add 30-60 on game day)
From Downtown Phoenix: 20-30 minutes (add 30-45 on game day)
From Airport: 25-35 minutes (add 30-60 on game day)
